paper.title: Multiple-Play Bandits in the Position-Based Model

settings.name_in_paper: Multiple-play bandits in the Position-Based Model (PBM)
unmapped: Semi-bandit feedback is censored: observation at position l is X_l*Y_l with unobserved examination variable Y_l ~ B(kappa_l)
Examination probabilities kappa_1>...>kappa_L>0 are known to the learner
Learner selects ordered list of L (=m) out of K arms; reward = number of clicks
settings.definition_quote: The PBM is characterized by examination parameters $(\kappa_l)_{1\leq l\leq L}$ ... the observation at position $l$, $Z_l(t)$, is \emph{censored} being the product of two independent Bernoulli variables $Y_l(t)$ and $X_l(t)$ ... The learner receives a reward $r_{A(t)} = \sum_{l=1}^L Z_l(t)$ ... we assume that the examination parameters $(\kappa_l)_{1\leq l \leq L}$ are known to the learner.

settings.name_in_paper: Multiple-play bandits in the Position-Based Model (PBM) (lower bound)
unmapped: Semi-bandit feedback is censored by unobserved examination variables Y_l ~ B(kappa_l)
Examination probabilities kappa_l known to the learner
settings.definition_quote: For the PBM, the following lower bound holds for any uniformly efficient algorithm

symbols.f_theta: value of the Graves-Lai-type LP: inf_{c>=0} sum_a Delta_a c_a s.t. inf_{lambda in B(theta)} sum_a I_a(theta,lambda) c_a >= 1

source.label: th:LB_opt
source.quote: The expected regret of any uniformly efficient algorithm satisfies \liminf_{T\rightarrow \infty} \frac{\mathds{E}_\theta R(T)}{\log T} \geq f(\theta), where f(\theta) = \inf_{c\succeq 0}\sum_{a\in \mathcal{A}} \Delta_{a}(\theta) c_a, s.t. \inf_{\lambda \in B(\theta)} \sum_{a} I_a(\theta,\lambda)c_a \geq 1.

results.notes: f_theta is essentially C_lin for this structured problem; kept as declared symbol.

symbols.c_PBM: sum_{k=L+1}^K min_{l<=L} Delta_{v_{k,l}}(theta)/kl(kappa_l theta_k, kappa_l theta_L), with v_{k,l}=(1,...,l-1,k,l,...,L-1)

source.label: th:LB_apm
source.quote: For the PBM, the following lower bound holds for any uniformly efficient algorithm: \liminf_{T\rightarrow \infty} \frac{\mathds{E}_\theta R(T)}{\log T} \geq \sum_{k=L+1}^K \min_{l \in \{1,\ldots,L\}} \frac{\Delta_{v_{k,l}}(\theta)}{d(\kappa_l\theta_k,\kappa_l\theta_L)}, where $v_{k,l} := (1,\dots,l-1,k,l,\dots,L-1)$.

results.notes: Text notes it can be further lower bounded by kappa_L sum_k (theta_L-theta_k)/d(kappa_L theta_k, kappa_L theta_L).

symbols.C_0: constant C_0(epsilon) independent of model parameters
symbols.Delta_perm: min gap over permutations of the optimal action other than a*

source.label: th:pbm-ucb
source.quote: Let $C(\kappa) = \min_{1\leq l\leq L} [(\sum_{j=1}^L\kappa_j)^2/l+(\sum_{j=1}^l\kappa_j)^2]/\kappa_L^2$ and $\Delta = \min_{a \in \sigma(a^*) \setminus a^*} \Delta_a$ ... Using PBM-UCB with $\delta=(1+\epsilon)\log(t)$ ... $\mathds{E}[R(T)] \leq C_0(\epsilon) + 16(1+\epsilon) C(\kappa)\log T ( \frac{L}{\Delta} +\sum_{k\notin a^*}\frac{1}{\kappa_L(\theta_L-\theta_k)})$.

results.notes: L (list length) mapped to m. Index uses log t so treated as anytime. Regret defined through means (pseudo-regret).

bound.expression: (1+eps_alg)**2*log(T)*sum_subopt(kappa_L*(theta_L - theta_i)/kl(kappa_L*theta_i, kappa_L*(theta_L - eta_gap))) + C_1 + C_2/T**beta_exp + C_3

source.label: th:pbm-pie
source.quote: Using PBM-PIE with $\delta = (1+\epsilon)\log(t)$ and $\epsilon > 0$, for any $\eta<\min_{k<K} (\theta_k-\theta_{k+1})/2$, there exist problem-dependent constants $C_1(\eta)$, $C_2(\epsilon,\eta),C_3(\epsilon)$ and $\beta(\epsilon,\eta)$ such that \mathds{E}[R(T)] \leq (1+\epsilon)^2 \log(T)\sum_{k=L+1}^K \frac{\kappa_L (\theta_L - \theta_k)}{d(\kappa_L\theta_k,\kappa_L(\theta_L-\eta))} + C_1(\eta) + \frac{C_2(\epsilon,\eta)}{T^{\beta(\epsilon,\eta)}}+C_3(\epsilon).

results.notes: Algorithm pseudo-code uses U_k(t,(1+eps)log T), so horizon treated as known, although theorem states delta=(1+eps)log t. Asymptotically optimal when optimal exploring position is L.
